topics.title: Attention and sequence representation
topics.coverage: Token relationships, representation and a bounded architecture diagram.
topics.exclusions: Human cognition claims and implementation tutorials.
topics.evidence_required: Original architecture passages and a checked original illustration.

topics.title: Dataset provenance
topics.coverage: Origin, collection context, consent questions and intended uses.
topics.exclusions: Assuming a dataset is representative because documentation exists.
topics.evidence_required: Dataset documentation and applicable collection records.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Evaluation and reporting

topics.title: Failure and uncertainty
